notes.title: Store page is now open!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161291/154badee0acd38b6e358c510e56692683424666a.png[/img]

The store page for Survivor's Guilt is now available!
This game was originally released two years ago for smartphones and has been reworked for PC in landscape mode.

We developed this game with the idea of "making a game that will help in disaster prevention.
Thankfully, many people have played the game and it has won two awards from Google,

A huge earthquake has occurred, and people are waiting for rescue.
Various things happen during that time.

And what awaits those who are rescued and survive?
This game does not end when you clear the game,
The ending of the game is the most important theme I want to convey.

The price of the game is $5.99, and we will be offering a 20% off launch discount.
I hope you will put it on your wish list.
